about_the_game:
Ahoy, adventurer! The Pirates DLC takes you on a journey across treacherous waters and mysterious islands, packed with tricky puzzles and pirate flair.

  • A brand-new Caribbean environment with pirate vibes
  • 30 new levels filled with tricky puzzles and obstacles
  • Unique blocks expanding gameplay and level editor – islands, cliffs, and treasure chests
  • New wooden look for your cubes

Sail through danger, unlock hidden treasures, and conquer the high seas! Do you have what it takes to solve the pirates' hidden secrets?
